title: ME60111: Internal Combustion Engine
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Air standard and fuel–air cycle analysis of Otto, Diesel and limited pressure
cycles. Effect of design and operating parameters on cycle efficiency. Modified
fuel-air cycle considering heat losses and valve timing. Engine dynamics and
torque analysis. Fuels and combustion in S.I. engines, knocking and fuel
rating. Energy balance, volumetric efficiency, measurement of indicated and
brake power. Advanced theory of carburetion. Cooling of engine and governing of
engine. Ignition system: conventional and electronic. Supercharging. Variable
compression ratio engine. Wankel rotary combustion engine. Exhaust emissions,
its measurement and control. Fault diagnosis of S.I. Engines. Modelling of
I.C. Engine Combustion.
